main_issue: How to get Agent D's half-done analysis section finished before Thursday's deadline given D's bereavement, with B and C refusing to take it on

A-B.evidence: A pushes D to finish tonight (T9) while B questions it ('You should be with your family tonight', T10); B then accepts 'Okay, Agent D' (T13). Partial overlap, not clear alignment.

A-C.evidence: C only declined to take the section (T5); A's pressure on D (T7, T9) is never answered by C, so little interaction.

A-D.evidence: D first proposes finishing tomorrow night (T6); A says it's too late (T7); D concedes 'You're right... I can finish it tonight' (T8); A thanks D (T9).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take D's section (T4, T5) but do not address each other.

B-D.evidence: B questions D's plan to work tonight (T10); D insists 'It has to be done' (T12); B yields 'Okay, Agent D' (T13); D thanks B (T14).

C-D.evidence: C refuses to take the section (T5); D replies 'I understand' (T6) and later commits to finishing it themselves; no further exchange.
